outcome: Brown bloody discharge during embryo transfer
cohort: Infertile patients with symptomatic isthmocele undergoing in vitro fertilization (IVF)
finding: Non-invasive isthmocele treatment (NIIT) prior to frozen-thawed embryo transfer cycles in infertile patients with symptomatic isthmocele resulted in a significant reduction in isthmocele volume and elimination of intrauterine fluid and brown bloody discharge during embryo transfer.
